findings.title: The stored HK provenance permits natural_verified=true

evidence.detail: The extension validator requires production_allowed, buy_gate_updated, and orders_sent to be False, but omits natural_verified.
The actual eligibility reader explicitly sets natural_verified=False and notes a parent scheduler receipt is still required.
The Stage strict reader checks the three SAFETY_FLAGS and source bindings but does not reject natural_verified=true.
A synthetic R4 projector artifact changed only eligibility_asof.natural_verified to true; the actual R9 store materialized it and actual Stage _validate_hk_d1 accepted it.

findings.impact: A crafted or faulty caller can persist and stage-validate a false natural-verification claim even though the verified source reader currently emits False. This probe does not show that the normal producer emits True.
findings.recommendation: Require eligibility_asof.natural_verified is False at the R9 store and Stage strict boundary, and add a negative regression case.
findings.uncertainty: CANNOT_CONFIRM whether a separately documented legitimate producer may set this field to True; none was established in the reviewed package.

source_and_diff.changed_runtime_scope: The reviewed R4 patch adds a narrow HK provenance extension validator to the R9 store and explicit helper imports in both rebound owner functions. Assembly receipt states canonical, shared, Stage, and original data were not modified.
